title: customer-triage-and-capacity-sync-2028-03-14
notes:
Weekly Solutions/ProServices triage + capacity sync — 2028-03-14
Attendees: Tess Morales (owner), Ravi Kaur, Maya Alvarez, Devon Blake, Samir Rao, Leo Chen (SRE), Ana Soto (Customer success, Oceanic Retail)
Duration: 40m
Cadence: Weekly (Wed)

1) Quick context and goals
- Purpose: align on customer integration health, short-term capacity swaps, unblock in-flight handoffs to FieldEng, and surface regressions that need Eng attention.
- Theme this week: "soft-launch readiness" for two mid-market customers + spike in small onboarding requests (burst).

2) Customer status snapshots
- Oceanic Retail (pilot): onboarding at week 3. Current scope: private VPC deployment + S3-based artifact access. Blocker: network egress rule failing validation in private-deployments infra template.
  - Blocker ticket: JIRA-PROVIS-8421 (network egress validation false-positive).
  - Impact: cannot run end-to-end smoke tests; go-live target slipping by ~3 business days.
  - Temporary mitigation: DEV/QA run smoke tests using shared staging VPC (manual creds) — Maya to coordinate with SRE.
  - Action: Ravi to own remediation with infra team; ETA 2028-03-16.

- Nimbus Finance (dedicated): performance baseline established, but steady-state latency higher than SLA for long prompt chains (>1.5k tokens).
  - Investigation notes: observed KV cache thrashing on gpu-node-24 during 95th percentile loads.
  - Linked artifact: JIRA-OPS-9104.
  - Action: Devon to deploy KV-cache tuning profile (quantized L2 threshold) to canary pool by 2028-03-16; Samir to schedule shadow traffic run 2028-03-17.

- BlueLattice (hosted API trial): embeddings ingestion stalled; customer using mixed-batch ingestion pattern that trips current ingestion-rate limiter.
  - Immediate ask: relax rate-limiter for customer trial for 48h.
  - Action: Tess to approve temporary quota bump; operations to implement and monitor.

3) Capacity and reservations
- Dedicated pool utilization: forecasted 72% next week, with two mid-market launches planned.
- Capacity swap request: FieldEng asks for 1xA100 reserved for Nimbus Finance peak test window (3 hours, 2028-03-17 09:00–12:00 UTC).
  - Impact: may cause brief queueing for low-priority internal experiments.
  - Decision: Approved. Leo to update scheduler with priority windows and fallback policy.

4) Technical escalations and riskiest items
- Ingress validation edge-case: platform config schema mismatch for vendor-supplied load-balancer (seen in Oceanic Retail). If this recurs across customers we'll need a schema versioning patch.
  - Owner: Ravi; escalate to infra-schema working group if another hit occurs.

- KV cache thrash root cause uncertain; two hypotheses: (a) request routing imbalance across model shards, (b) client prompt pattern evicting prefix cache.
  - Action items: Devon will enable extra tracing flags for 48h; Samir will synthesize traces and create a short repro by 2028-03-18.

5) Action items (owner — due)
- Ravi Kaur — debug JIRA-PROVIS-8421 + submit infra patch or rollback validation, coordinate with SRE (due 2028-03-16).
- Maya Alvarez — run manual smoke tests on staging VPC, capture logs and test checklist (due 2028-03-15).
- Devon Blake — roll KV-cache tuning to canary, enable trace level 3 on affected nodes (due 2028-03-16).
- Samir Rao — schedule shadow traffic run and assemble repro trace bundle (due 2028-03-17).
- Tess Morales — approve temporary quota bump for BlueLattice trial and notify CS (done: 2028-03-14).
- Leo Chen — reserve GPU for Nimbus Finance peak window and update scheduler priorities (due 2028-03-15).
- Ana Soto (CS) — notify Oceanic Retail of temporary staging workaround and update go-live expectations (due 2028-03-15).

6) Discussion notes / open questions
- Should we create an "ingress-schemas" playbook for common vendor LB configs? Likely yes; provisional owners: Ravi + infra-schema WG.
- How aggressive should we be with temporary quota bumps for hosted trials? Need a short policy: temporary bump <= 48h with monitoring and manual rollback. Product to own.
- Can we automate a preflight that simulates vendor LB validation to catch mismatch earlier? SRE to prototype.

7) Minor updates / wins
- BlueLattice had a successful embeddings ingest after quota bump; first dataset indexed ~18% faster once ingest queueing cleared. CS reported early positive feedback.
- Internal experiment MLP-qual improved inference tail latency by ~6% in canary (non-customer-affecting); results posted in GH PR above.

8) Parking lot / follow-ups for next sync
- Draft ingress-schema playbook + sample configs (Ravi).
- Gather sample customer prompt patterns that cause KV cache churn (Samir + CS).
- Postmortem outline if Oceanic Retail go-live slips beyond 2028-03-18.

9) Next meeting
- 2028-03-21 16:00 UTC (weekly): agenda to include ingress playbook draft review and Nimbus Finance shadow run results.

End notes: rough/working doc — please add comments inline or drop notes to slack #se-proservices-onboarding-thread-03-13.
